Bribe to president? President is idx 2, cash-rich decisions... Influence gives max influence bonus 5% bank commission. Currently all influence 1; tie_order 2,1,0 — I'd lose ties. Same influence gain; give to idx1? Either way rival gains cash. Give to idx 2 (weaker cash?) — 2 has 19.5 vs 37.5. To maximize my relative rank, give to the poorer. Choice 15.

But also could produce instead. Influence gain 1 gives ~2.25 + control of two law rounds + weight. But cost 5M cash reduces my rank. Bank 45M, payout difference: commission 5% split... Actually influence bonus: 5% of bank (~2.25M) plus law control could prevent taxes. I think bribe 5 to 2 is good.
